children: Private-sector house approvals in Australia dropped 5.3% month-on-month to 10,432 units in September 2026, flash data showed.
The latest result came after rising 3.7% in the previous month.
Permits declined in New South Wales (-1.8%) and Victoria (-0.1%), while growing in Western Australia (1.9%), South Australia (1.8%), and Queensland (0.4%).
On an annual basis, private-sector house approvals rose 9.6%.

title: Australia Private House Approvals Fall 5.3% in September
